dataset_name: Authentic FEVER Benchmark (Independent Corpus & Evidence Groups)

methodology.corpus_independence: Fixed evidence corpus constructed from reference dev_pool independently of test_pool
methodology.evidence_groups: FEVER alternative acceptable evidence sets and multi-hop sets strictly preserved in evidence_sets
methodology.synthetic_separation: Zero synthetic passages in data/processed/corpus.jsonl (quarantined in data/controlled/)
methodology.retrieval_protocol: Recall@k requires at least one complete evidence set in top-k; MRR evaluates first gold passage
